sample_unit: patients (phase 2); phase 1 rated by six ophthalmologists

links.outcome: Objective readability complexity of LLM responses to patient dry eye questions
links.effect: GPT-4 responses were highly complex, average readability score 12.86 vs 10.87 (Qwen), 11.53 (Baichuan 2), 11.26 (PaLM 2), p<0.05; Baichuan 2 more comprehensible to patients than GPT-4 (3.91 vs 4.61 as reported).
links.quote: However, the readability analysis revealed that GPT-4's responses were highly complex, with an average score of 12.86 (p < 0.05) compared to scores of 10.87, 11.53, and 11.26 for Qwen, Baichuan 2, and PaLM 2, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and readability of multiple LLMs answering patient inquiries about dry eye disease, tested with clinician raters and simulated patient interactions, without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail.
